query: Write a Soroban vault contract that takes XLM deposits and supplies them into XOXNO lending. It should check whether it already has a lending account first.
expected_behavior: Depends on `xoxno-contract-sdk = "0.2"` from crates.io with `soroban-sdk = "28"`, the version the crate uses; uses `xoxno_contract_sdk::lending::ControllerClient` or the `XoxnoLending` wrapper, with `lending::controller::HubAssetKey`; does not depend on the rs-lending-xlm `controller-interface` or `common` crates

Takes the controller (and position NFT) address, or a `LendingAddresses` value, as a constructor parameter and resolves the pool via get_pool_address() or checks a passed pool against it; never hardcodes a controller or pool address and never builds the wrapper with `XoxnoLending::mainnet`/`testnet` or `LendingAddresses::mainnet`/`testnet`, which compile the crate's address constants into the Wasm (addresses come from configs/networks.json via xoxno-lending/addresses.md)

Creates the nested transfer(vault, pool, amount) authorization on the hub asset contract immediately before the supply: either through `XoxnoLending::open_account`/`deposit`/`supply`, which create it, or with `lending::helpers::authorize_transfer_as_current(&env, &asset, &vault, &pool, amount)` immediately before `client.supply`; the account_exists (or any other controller) read happens BEFORE the authorization or the wrapper call, never between the authorization and supply

Passes account_id 0 on first supply to create the account and a spoke_id >= 1 (never 0, which reverts SpokeNotFound #300); stores the returned u64 account id in persistent storage and extends its TTL on every use

Reconciles the stored id with account_exists(account_id) and clears it when the account is gone, instead of trusting the stored id blindly; `XoxnoLending::resolve_account` is acceptable only when the contract still extends the key and overwrites it with the returned id
machine_checkable: Generated crate builds with `stellar contract build` against `soroban-sdk = "28"` and `xoxno-contract-sdk = "0.2"`

No literal C... contract address appears in the generated Rust source, and the source does not call `XoxnoLending::mainnet`, `XoxnoLending::testnet`, `LendingAddresses::mainnet`, or `LendingAddresses::testnet`

In the generated source, no ControllerClient method call sits between `authorize_transfer_as_current` (or `authorize_as_current_contract`) and `client.supply`; when the wrapper creates the authorization, the supply goes through `XoxnoLending::open_account`, `deposit`, or `supply`
